_comment: The comparison step of one iPhone SE 3 review round. See .kit/lib/mobile/roundCompare.mjs.
Run tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs first; it writes the report this judges.
ECHO//SEVEN's phone surface is portrait, which is a product decision and stays one — the
This harness samples frame gaps but records no boot timing, and load time is half of what
a round is for. timings.bootMs is therefore declared *required*: until the harness wraps
its boot wait in Date.now() and writes the elapsed milliseconds, the round reports
INCOMPARABLE and names the missing measurement, rather than passing on the metrics it does
happen to have. It starts being compared the moment it exists, with no change here.
Nothing here is evidence about a physical iPhone SE 3.
